\begin{minipage}{\textwidth}\footnotesize\setstretch{1.0}\emph{Notes.} Share of simulated markets with no predictability in which the procedure declares, at the nominal 5\% level (one-sided), that the strategy beats the benchmark: buy-and-hold (the strategy's return minus the market's) or cash (the strategy's own excess return). A correct test rejects about 5\% of the time. 5,000 replications per null; MC s.e.\ is the Monte Carlo standard error. Bootstrap critical values use the warp-speed method of Giacomini, Politis and White (2013). Panel D is for reference: each effective number of designs is computed within each simulated market from the correlation matrix of the 56 difference series (Section~6.1 and Appendix~A); its average over the GARCH null is in parentheses; the Deflated Sharpe Ratio rejects when it exceeds 0.95. Bold: rate more than 2.58 standard errors above 5\%.
